jobs.title: Software Engineer II, AI Applications
jobs.description: Build source-grounded AI applications in Python and FastAPI. Develop retrieval-augmented generation pipelines using hybrid retrieval, embeddings, vector search, evaluation harnesses, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, and React interfaces. Collaborate with historians, librarians, and product partners to translate complex research workflows into reliable software. Candidates should have 3 or more years of professional software experience and strong testing habits with pytest.

jobs.title: Documentation Engineer, Developer Platform
jobs.description: Own developer documentation for a public API platform. Write tutorials, API references, architecture explanations, and release notes; build docs-as-code tooling in TypeScript and Python; test code examples; interview engineers and customers; and improve developer experience through research and clear source-grounded explanations. Two years of software or technical writing experience preferred.

jobs.title: QA Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Create API and user-interface test automation for healthcare applications. Use Python, pytest, JavaScript, SQL, GitHub Actions, regression testing, and exploratory QA. Work closely with developers and non-technical healthcare specialists to reproduce defects and translate requirements into reliable test plans. Requires 2 years of software testing or development experience.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: Help customers integrate a data and AI platform through REST APIs, Python, JavaScript, technical discovery, implementation planning, troubleshooting, documentation, and product feedback. Translate between client domain experts and engineering teams. Three years of software development, support engineering, or implementation experience is preferred.

jobs.title: Research Software Engineer
jobs.description: Develop Python tools for digital humanities research, archival metadata, semantic search, document processing, data analysis, and public scholarly interfaces. Partner with historians and librarians, maintain tested research software, and document methods for non-specialist users. A bachelor's degree and 2 years of relevant programming experience are required.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.description: Build a TypeScript and React geospatial authoring application backed by Python services and REST APIs. Work with Next.js, Vite, state management, automated testing, SQL, deployment, and product design. We value self-directed engineers who can own features from requirements through release. Four years of relevant experience preferred, including substantial project work.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description: Analyze product and public-sector datasets with Python, SQL, Excel, reporting, experimentation, and data visualization. Explain findings to stakeholders and improve recommendation and campaign performance. Requires 2 years of analytics, feeds, marketing data, or software experience.

jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer
jobs.description: Lead architecture for a Python distributed platform, mentor a team of engineers, own reliability strategy, and set technical direction across the company. Requires 10+ years of professional experience, five years operating distributed systems, and experience managing technical roadmaps.

jobs.title: Junior React Developer
jobs.description: Build React and JavaScript interfaces in a junior development role.

jobs.title: Python Developer
jobs.description: Develop Python APIs and data pipelines for a European product team. Applicants must be resident in Germany.

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer — Part-Time
jobs.description: Provide API troubleshooting and customer support twenty hours per week.

jobs.title: AI Research Intern
jobs.description: Assist with LLM evaluation and retrieval experiments during a twelve-week internship.
